# 9LMNTS Studio // Interactive Creative Operating System

> 9LMNTS Studio is a next-generation creative agency and sovereign technology suite bridging interactive 3D spatial experiences, low-latency audio DAWs, and decentralized event infrastructure.

## Platforms
- [9LMNTS Studio Master Cockpit](https://9lmntsstudio.com)
- [Artist OS Workstation](https://artist.9lmntsstudio.com)
- [Sound Clash OS Arena](https://clash.9lmntsstudio.com)

## Stations
- Station 01: Project LOA Metaverse Universe
- Station 02: Original Music Vault & Stem Chopper
- Station 03: 9LMNTS Studio Core Services & Telemetry
- Station 04: AI Voice Operator (Gemini Live API)
- Station 05: Studio Services & Commercial Video Ads
- Station 06: The Helm (Founder Dossier & Admin Gateway)
- Station 07: Sound Clash OS Live Battle Arena
- Station 08: Live Events & AR Merch Wearables
- Station 09: ArtistOS Creator HQ DAW
